title: The Overlord's Pharmacologist
description: Reach a mature Ars Elixirum mastery milestone. This records alchemy-pharmacology as an established discipline of the reign without pretending level 50 exhausts a system whose native mastery continues far beyond the authored quest boundary.
description_completed: Alchemy-pharmacology is established as a mature discipline of the reign; Ars Elixirum's continuing mastery remains open-ended native progression.
